verdict.rationale: Windmill ships an official CLI (`wmill`) documented for interacting with instances from the terminal, deploying from Git repos, and syncing commits—confirmed by both docs and a dedicated probe. This directly satisfies the 'official CLI' story for AI-native/agentic workflows (e.g., scripting deployments, CI integration). Missing for 10: independent hands-on community reports specifically validating the CLI's AI-native usage patterns (e.g., agent-driven CLI invocation) beyond first-party docs.
